title: Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Taqwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Tawakkul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. D — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Taqwa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tawakkul; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Twahara; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Zakat:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
